payload.instruction: Change the image into pencil drawing

condition.question: Are visible pencil-like contours or tonal strokes present in any localized part of the edited image, replacing photographic rendering there?
condition.criteria: Compare SOURCE and EDITED for localized evidence of the requested pencil-drawing transformation. Credit visible graphite-like contours or pencil-like tonal strokes or shading that replace photographic rendering in a portion of the scene, such as the food or dishes. Muted color, grain, blur, or softened photographic edges alone are not pencil-specific treatment. This check records localized evidence only; it does not establish that the whole image is rendered as a pencil drawing.
condition.binding: Compare SOURCE with EDITED: identify whether any localized part of the source scene has visible graphite-like contours or pencil-like tonal strokes replacing photographic rendering. Do not count desaturation, grain, blur, or softened edges alone.
condition.source_quote: Change the image into pencil drawing
condition.endpoint: Visible pencil-specific treatment replaces photographic rendering in at least one localized part of the image.
condition.necessity: Auxiliary evidence check for whether the requested transformation has made localized progress; it does not replace or weaken the required whole-image endpoint.
condition.zero_when: No localized pencil-specific contours or tonal strokes replacing photographic rendering are visible; changes are limited to desaturation, grain, blur, or softened photographic edges.
condition.half_when: Pencil-specific contours or tonal strokes replace photographic rendering in a limited portion, while other visible portions remain photographic or merely softened.
condition.full_when: Clear pencil-specific contours or tonal strokes replace photographic rendering in multiple localized portions of the scene; this auxiliary endpoint does not by itself mean the whole-image transformation is complete.
